Snapshot: small indie studio (mobile/social) building live chat and ephemeral rooms. Very latency sensitive — target p50 < 150ms for streaming messages in US. Primary concerns: abuse/spam filtering, auto-moderation tuning, and predictable per-message cost. Want a self-serve path but need a short technical call to validate:

- Workload: real-time player-to-player chat + ephemeral group rooms, occasional system messages (matchmaking, notifications). Expect spikes during events (concurrency ~300-800 users peak).
- Latency/throughput targets: p50 <150ms, p95 <400ms for message generation + streaming; ability to sustain 200 rps during events with graceful degradation.
- Cost sensitivity: tight budget; prefer hosted metered billing. Prototype wants to use smaller open models for most replies and upgrade path to higher-quality models for gated flows.
- Moderation: need built-in content moderation or easy webhook to their in-house classifier; support for custom blocklists and automatic user temp-bans. Must be able to tune thresholds quickly.
- Model preferences: open models (Llama family or equivalent) for cost; willing to test Redwood-verified variants. Require model fallback to smaller quantized variant if capacity/budget hit.
- Security: public cloud (AWS us-east-1) is fine; require audit logs for admin actions and simple retention controls. No enterprise SSO yet.

Notes from call: "We need something we can drop in tonight to protect players from spam, but also evolve to smarter contextual moderation." - Ari Navarro (CTO).

POC ask: 2-week trial with streaming example, moderation hooks, and an estimate of cost at 200 rps. SE recommended: sample app + code snippet (JS/Unity) + Docs link.
